profile_text.body:
Accenture plc describes itself as a company that embraces change to create 360-degree value and shared success for clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities. Its website says it works across industries and around the world, using emerging technologies and human ingenuity to create better experiences. The company positions its work around what it calls the Human + AI era, including redesigning work, accelerating skills and reinventing HR so people and AI work together.

The site's AI-related material is advisory rather than product-specific. It states that after two years of rapid AI acceleration, global executives enter 2026 with confidence but face gaps in scale and value. It also discusses AI pushing power demand beyond grid limits, data center developers shifting to a power-first strategy, and cyber resilience as a strategic mandate in an AI-driven threat landscape. Accenture says it is helping the European Commission's Directorate-General for International Partnerships to scale AI across global operations. No specific AI products are named in the company's site text.

Accenture plc is a for-profit public company traded under ticker ACN, with CIK 0001467373 and headquarters in Dublin, L2. It is also listed under the alias ACCENTURE PLC-CL A. No lawsuits or MCP servers are recorded for the company.
